verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly detail import/export in multiple portable formats (Insomnia JSON/YAML, Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, cURL) with UI import methods and Inso CLI support for automation/CI, plus Git Sync for version-controlled portability across tools. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of round-trip fidelity between tools beyond vendor docs.
